items.model: GPT-6 Astra (broad availability — API and AWS)
items.basis: Astra shipped Sep 3 to Daybreak customers; OpenAI says ChatGPT tiers, the API and AWS follow over the week, cyber capabilities gated.
Musk said Sep 2 on X it ships in ten days as a 2.1T-parameter pre-train. No xAI model card; Kalshi's by-Sep-4 leg collapsed.
Polymarket Sep 30 leg 93% at last clean read; book still trading on $1.61M after Mythos 5.1 shipped Sep 1. Per-leg odds did not return this sweep.
Meta says the max reasoning tier ships shortly after additional safety testing; no dated market exists.
Oct 31 flat at 69% a thirteenth sweep; Sep 30 firmed to 21%, Sep 15 4%, on $1.21M volume. Repeated slips since the June I/O tease.
OpenAI has said the Ultrafast tier broadens beyond limited access; no date given and no dated market.
Hy4 preview shipped Aug 28; Tencent has not dated the general-availability release and no market exists.
Haiku tier has not been refreshed since 4.5 in Oct 2025; widely expected but unannounced, no dated market.
Zuckerberg has said on X that open-weight Muse Spark versions are planned; still no date and no dated market.
Manifold before-2027 flat at 66%; before-December 45%, before-November 10%, before-October 3%, before-September 1%.
